name: Seek
tagline: Find lost earbuds, watches and Bluetooth tags with a hot and cold meter.
description: Seek finds the Bluetooth things you lost. Pick your earbuds, watch, fitness band, speaker or BLE tag from the list of paired and nearby devices, then walk around: a big hot and cold meter, a rough distance, a closer or farther arrow, and a beep or vibration that speeds up as you get near guide you to it. For connected earbuds, a Play sound button plays a loud tone through them. No account, no location tracking. The only network use is the update check in Settings.
